blocks.text: 9 Mission neighbourhood guides, from downtown to Hemlock Valley

parts.t: One guide for each Mission area on my site. Each covers schools, parks, planning, flood notes and what to check before you buy, with a source next to every fact. Four of the nine areas are in the Fraser Valley Regional District, not the City of Mission, and each guide says which it is.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. Updated October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years.
Where a guide names a bus route or a West Coast Express train, check the current BC Transit and TransLink schedules before you plan a trip.

blocks.text: The city: downtown, Silverdale, Hatzic, Stave Falls and Steelhead

parts.t: These follow MLS® sub-area names, which are not City boundaries. The City of Mission publishes no boundary for the MLS® sub-areas these guides cover. Hatzic also takes in Hatzic Island, which is in the Fraser Valley Regional District.
Mission City Station and the West Coast Express, Mission Leisure Centre, Centennial Park, the Cedar Valley plan, central-city schools, the Official Community Plan and flood notes.
Silverdale and the southwest, the Silverdale planning area, Silverdale Elementary, parks, ALR land and flood notes.
City of Mission and FVRD Area G
Hatzic Lake and Hatzic Island, Neilson Regional Park, Xá:ytem (Hatzic Rock), Hatzic Elementary and Hatzic Middle School.
The Powerhouse at Stave Falls, Hayward Lake, Rolley Lake Provincial Park, Stave Falls Elementary and rural zoning.
Cardinal Street, the Steelhead Community Hall, the Municipal Forest and the Rural Mission Strategy.

blocks.text: Rural areas east and north of Mission, in the Fraser Valley Regional District

parts.t: These areas carry a Mission label in the MLS® but are in the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD), not the City of Mission. FVRD plans, bylaws and services apply to them, and Hemlock Valley is about 55 km from Mission.
The Hatzic Valley Official Community Plan, Cascade Falls Regional Park, Dewdney Elementary, ALR land and the valley road.
Electoral Area G, Dewdney Regional Park, Inch Creek Hatchery, Dewdney and Deroche elementary schools, dikes and the dyked lowland.
The Area C Official Community Plan, Harrison Rise, Deroche Elementary, parks and boat launches, and no BC Transit route.
The Hemlock Valley Official Community Plan, Sasquatch Mountain Resort, avalanche zones, Hemlock Valley Road and mountain hazards.

Which Mission areas have a guide?
Do these areas have official boundaries?

The names are MLS® sub-areas. Neither the City of Mission nor the Fraser Valley Regional District publishes them as boundaries. Each guide says how it places its area and gives facts by street address, so check the address you care about.
Are all of these areas in the City of Mission?
No. Mission BC, Mission-West, Stave Falls and Steelhead are in the City of Mission, and Hatzic is split between the City and the Fraser Valley Regional District (FVRD).
are in the FVRD, so FVRD bylaws, plans and services apply, not the City’s. Each guide says which applies.
Which guide covers the West Coast Express and downtown Mission?
covers Mission City Station, the Mission Leisure Centre, Centennial Park, Cedar Valley and the central-city schools.
How do I check the school for an address?
Public schools in Mission are run by School District 75 (SD75). Catchments are set by address, so confirm an exact address with
, which also publishes a catchment map. Each guide lists the schools I found for its area, and says when I found none.
Do the guides have flood notes?

Yes. Each guide has a flood or hazard section built from City, FVRD or Province pages, and says plainly when I could not find detail for a specific street. Ask me or the City or FVRD about a specific lot.
Can you check a Mission address for me?
Yes. Send me the address with the form below. I’ll look up its zone, plan designation and any ALR or flood questions and get back to you before you write an offer.
